Individual & Performance Coaching

Personalised 1:1 football and athlete development with experienced, qualified coaches. Since 2019 we’ve worked with hundreds of players across the region, and individual development is one of our fastest-growing areas.

Discuss your development
THE PROTEUS WAY / 1:1 + SMALL GROUP

WHO IT’S FOR

Engaged, motivated players who want to strengthen specific areas of their game, prepare for a season or take the next step.

01

Built around you

Every session is tailored to the player: technical ability, decision-making, tactical understanding, confidence and overall performance. Available all year round.

02

Highly qualified coaches

Football operations are led by our Director, an OFC A Licence coach who oversees the academy and first team at a large membership club. Our leading coaches hold OFC B Licences.

03

Real milestones

We help players progress beyond the environments where they started: towards overseas university opportunities, high school first teams, senior men’s debuts and higher levels of competition.

  • Since 2019Hundreds of players coached
  • OFC ALicence-qualified Director
  • 10+ yearsFootball expertise, grassroots to high performance

QUESTIONS.

Ask us something else
Who is individual coaching for?

Engaged, motivated players who want to strengthen specific areas of their game, prepare for a season or take the next step.

What does a session cover?

Every session is tailored to the player: technical ability, decision-making, tactical understanding, confidence and overall performance.

When is coaching available?

All year round. Tell us about the player and their goals, and we’ll talk through the options.

Which programme is right for us?

Tell us who the programme is for, your sport and what you want to achieve. Our team can discuss the options for an individual player, preschool, school, club, community organisation or retirement village.
